title: Lab retest of the marble finds no iridium
summary: Matthew Zodakis tells of Lab retest of the marble finds no iridium, about present day at Matthew Zodakis's lab, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So I can already tell like this is going to be nowhere near dense enough for a heavy metal like uh aridium.

related.note: This is the same marble and the same question of what it is made of as telling 4, but Zodakis's lab retest finds no iridium, so the two claims contradict each other.

plain: A man named Matthew Zodakis says that a marble said to come from a crash site, which an earlier scan had read as about 40 percent iridium, a rare and very heavy metal, was tested again in his lab. Handling it, he says he could tell at once it was nowhere near dense enough to hold a heavy metal like iridium. His retest cuts against the earlier claim that the marble was made of unusual material.
